# ferriskey_client_maintenance_whitelist_entry (Resource)

Allows a user or every holder of a role to keep logging in to a FerrisKey client while its maintenance mode is enabled. Exactly one of `user_id` or `role_id` must be set. Entries cannot be updated, so every attribute change forces a new resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ferriskey_client_maintenance_whitelist_entry" "ops" {
  realm       = "acme"
  client_uuid = ferriskey_client.app.client_uuid
  role_id     = ferriskey_role.ops.role_uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_uuid` (String) UUID of the client. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `realm` (String) Name of the realm owning the client. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `role_id` (String) UUID of the whitelisted role. Conflicts with `user_id`. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `user_id` (String) UUID of the whitelisted user. Conflicts with `role_id`. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `entry_id` (String) UUID of the whitelist entry.
- `id` (String) Resource identifier in the form `{realm}/{client_uuid}/{entry_id}`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by {realm}/{client_uuid}/{entry_id}.
terraform import ferriskey_client_maintenance_whitelist_entry.ops acme/3a8c6128-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/7b1d9e44-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
